primary_metric: task success on silent slicing migration and error-only cleanup scope
stopping_rule: Run one paired AB/BA pass per task (four initial cells, estimated under 10 minutes from the 2026-08-07 language/toolchain runs). Repeat only a task whose current-skill cell fails or whose pair is unstable, at most once. If current skills fail again, run one frozen Kimi/K3 fallback pair for that task and report it separately. Maximum twelve cells including conditional retries and fallbacks; do not repeat successful stable pairs.
